description: DisplayXR organization profile

description: DisplayXR Browser — developer-preview Chromium that renders the web normally + weaves glasses-free inline-3D on DisplayXR hardware (Step-B fork productization).

name: displayxr-cef-host
description: CEF offscreen-render browser stand-in that drives the real DisplayXR display-processor weave via XR_EXT_weave (#625, Step A). The host never weaves.

name: displayxr-common
description: Generalized off-axis frustum projection math library

name: displayxr-demo-avatar
description: DisplayXR demo — a transparent, click-through 3D avatar that floats over your desktop (OpenXR + native Vulkan).

name: displayxr-demo-earthview
description: Streaming 3D city viewer on Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles for glasses-free 3D displays (DisplayXR / OpenXR).

name: displayxr-demo-gaussiansplat
description: DisplayXR demo — real-time 3D Gaussian Splatting viewer for glasses-free 3D displays (OpenXR + Vulkan, Windows & macOS).

name: displayxr-demo-mediaplayer
description: Lightweight cross-platform stereo image & video player for the DisplayXR runtime — OpenXR client, Vulkan, FFmpeg decode. The minimal counterpart to LeiaPlayerWin.

name: displayxr-demo-modelviewer
description: DisplayXR demo — glasses-free 3D glTF 2.0 PBR model viewer (OpenXR + Vulkan, Windows & macOS).

name: displayxr-extensions
description: OpenXR extension specs and headers for 3D displays

name: displayxr-installer
description: One-click installer for DisplayXR — a single .exe / .pkg that sets up the runtime, Shell, and Leia SR plug-in.

name: displayxr-leia-plugin
description: DisplayXR Leia SR display-processor plug-in

name: displayxr-mcp
description: Tiny embeddable MCP (Model Context Protocol) server framework for DisplayXR — JSON-RPC 2.0 + stdio↔socket adapter, no runtime/shell coupling

name: displayxr-runtime
description: Lightweight OpenXR runtime for 3D displays · Windows, macOS, Android

name: displayxr-shell-releases
description: DisplayXR Shell — spatial window manager for 3D displays. Installers, docs, and issue tracking.

name: displayxr-unity
description: Unity plugin for eye-tracked 3D light field displays via OpenXR

name: displayxr-unity-samples
description: DisplayXR Unity plugin samples — BiRP/URP/HDRP pipeline tests + the Desktop Avatar showcase, with one shared installer

name: displayxr-unreal
description: Unreal Engine plugin for DisplayXR

name: displayxr-unreal-test
description: Unreal test project for the DisplayXR plugin — sample scene and setup to validate the plugin against new releases

name: displayxr-vendor-template
description: Vendor-neutral starter kit for a DisplayXR display-processor plug-in (no vendor SDK required).

name: displayxr-web
description: Inline-3D web samples + JS helper for the DisplayXR Browser — the analog of immersive-web/webxr-samples. Served via GitHub Pages.

name: displayxr-website
description: DisplayXR project website — displayxr.org
